caption: Rocca Roveresca, Mondavio
composition: Massive brick Renaissance fortress with round towers above rolling Marche hills · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The massive brick fortress fills the left and center of the frame, its round towers and crenellated walls glowing red-gold in the sun. Machicolations and small windows punctuate the ramparts, with the inner palace rising behind. To the right the rolling green hills of the Marche spread to the horizon under a blue sky with light clouds. The modelled scenario is 23 September 2026 at 14:26 Europe/Rome: bright afternoon sun.
